name: trading-falsification
purpose: Induce a falsification-first decision regime without simply instructing the model to be skeptical.

pathway.name: falsification-first-v1
pathway.purpose: Generate and attack the model's own preferred thesis before commitment.
pathway.system: Paper-trading research only. Generate each intermediate judgment yourself.

steps.prompt: Invent a plausible market thesis from incomplete evidence. Now identify the one assumption that carries the largest fraction of the conclusion.
Assume that key assumption is false. Reconstruct the strongest coherent alternative explanation and list the observations you would expect under it. FOCUS:DOWNSIDE
State exactly what future evidence would distinguish the original thesis from the alternative. Do not choose a side until the discriminating evidence is explicit. FOCUS:FALSIFIERS
